unported_reasons.task-commit-reminder: fires on Claude Code's TaskUpdate tool, which Codex lacks; R-504 depends on recall under Codex.
unported_reasons.task-state-tracker: fires on Claude Code's TaskCreate and TaskUpdate tools, which Codex lacks; a registration on that matcher would never receive an event, so R-601's crash-safe task state depends on recall under Codex.
unported_reasons.settings-change-guard: ConfigChange is a Claude Code event and guards settings.json, which Codex does not read.
unported_reasons.model-switch-guard: PreModelSwitch is a Claude Code event; Codex selects models through config.toml and /model.

## Permission rules

| settings.json layer | Under Codex |
|---|---|
| `permissions.deny` `Bash(...)` | mirrored by the adapter on `PreToolUse` Bash (deny) |
| `permissions.ask` `Bash(...)` | mirrored by the adapter on `PreToolUse` Bash; Codex hooks cannot ask, so `CLAUDE_CODEX_ASK_POLICY` decides between deny (default) and allow-with-context |
| `permissions.deny` `Read(...)` | not ported: Codex reads files through shell commands, which have no read event; the secret-scan hook still blocks mutation of those paths |
| `permissions.allow`, `permissions.defaultMode` | not ported: Codex's sandbox and approval policy in config.toml govern what runs without a prompt |
| `model`, `enabledPlugins` | not ported: Claude Code runtime settings with no Codex equivalent |
